reply_text:
Before choosing, I'll measure how fast it is on turn-sized text, both called in-process and started fresh for each turn.Both capture paths (typed turns and external turns) go through `session-mode--record-turn`, so one change covers everything that reaches 象. I'll write the handoff.Speed isn't a problem for per-turn use, so no port is needed. I measured it:

| Case | Time |
|---|---|
| Typical turn (~850 bytes), in-process | 0.3 ms |
| Long turn (~17 KB), in-process | 6 ms |
| Starting a fresh Python process per turn | 30–40 ms, nearly all interpreter startup |

Even the slowest option is 40 ms, next to dictation and model replies that take seconds, so you won't notice it. I'd keep **one Python source for both uses**. A Clojure port would be a second copy of the rules, and the two could drift so your turns and 小象 users get different redaction. The only speed problem is bulk scanning (about 0.5 s per MB of logs). That's a 小象 issue, and it can be fixed in readable Python, for example by skipping very long encoded blobs early.

**I've sent the capture wiring to codex-1** (job `invoke-1790655455523-27659-d6f36f5b`, park `park-4a136fdf…`, packet in `storage/futon3c/secret-scan/packet-2.md`):
- **Where:** in `session-mode--record-turn`. Typed turns and external turns both go through it, so one change covers everything that reaches 象.
- **When:** secrets are redacted before quotes are split out and before anything is written to disk or sent to 象. The public feed is built from these records, so it gets redacted text too.
- **If the scan fails,** for example a missing script or an error, the turn isn't recorded or dispatched. An unscanned turn never reaches 象.
- **Alert:** an Emacs warning naming the kinds and how many, never the value. The record also gets a `secrets_redacted` field.
- **Tests:** a key is redacted and doesn't leak into the warning; a clean turn is unchanged; the fail-closed case; and sentence offsets still line up after redaction.

**What this doesn't cover:** the agent you addressed the turn to has already received it unredacted. That includes me in this buffer. The redaction protects the stored record, 象 and the public feed. Keeping secrets away from the agent you're talking to would need a hook before sending, which is a separate change.

**Still running:** the 7-day log count (`bg-1790654905112-1`). Next after the review is the `turn_margin_html.py` check before publishing.
